To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the application of the video prediction models and techniques for the urban traffic forecasting task is effective both in the terms of the observed forecasting accuracy and the development and training efforts.
the video prediction and spatio-temporal traffic forecasting are two closely related fields of research and that video prediction techniques are applicable for traffic forecasting.

video prediction models and techniques can be effectively transferred to urban traffic forecasting domain and that the obtained forecasting performance can be comparable or even better than state-of-the-art forecasting models developed specifically for traffic data.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following question: Can we learn from video prediction models and transfer their ideas to the urban traffic domain? The answer is yes, and we demonstrate this by transferring video prediction methodologies to the spatiotemporally structured urban traffic forecasting task.
the transfer of video prediction models to traffic forecasting domain.
the application of transfer learning for solving the problem of spatiotemporel urban traffic forecasting.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
transfer learning in the context of urban traffic forecasting is a promising direction for further research.
the transfer of video prediction methodologies is a promising direction of development for the spatiotemperal urban traffic forecasting domain.
transfer learning can be a powerful tool for the development of new forecasting models and algorithms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
transfer learning is a promising approach in urban traffic forecasting.

video prediction and traffic forecasting are similar in their data structure, and therefore the methodologies and models developed for one domain can be transferred and applied for solving the problems of the other.
transfer learning is a very powerful concept and can lead to a significant increase in the forecasting accuracy of urban traffic.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the transfer of ideas, algorithms, and techniques between fields can lead to the development of new models and approaches for solving real world problems.
the application of ideas and models from video prediction to the traffic forecasting domain is effective.
transfer learning between different applied domains can be a fruitful and effective way of improving forecasting accuracy and reducing development and training efforts.
